Name:
🏆 A$AP Rocky - Whiskey
(feat. Westside Gunn & Gorillaz)
Notes: Song played at Le Gala des Pièces in Paris, France on January 26th, 2024. In this performance there was an included orchestra playing over the song. The track features some adlibs from Westside Gunn and a few lines from Gorillaz as the song serves as a part of the three artists time working together in November 2023. The song is also rumored to be a later version of the unknown song fan-dubbed "Skinny P" due to the slight similarity in the beat, but this is not confirmed. The track features a small sample from Rocky's song "Telephone Calls", but it's possible this was accidentally played as it was awkwardly placed.
